senses.whyCN: 活在手上的技能必须被展示，而非仅被描述，因此师徒制是独立通道。

senses.title: Institutional transmission
senses.definition: the passing of culture through schools, churches and formal training
senses.definitionCN: 文化经学校、教会与正式训练传递
senses.example: Schools became the main institution of cultural transmission in the nineteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 学校在十九世纪成为文化传递的主要机构。
senses.why: Institutions stabilize transmission: they repeat the same lesson to many people at once.
senses.whyCN: 机构使传递稳定：它们同时向许多人重复同一课。

senses.title: Transmission with modification
senses.definition: the passing on of culture with small changes at each step, so the copy is never exact
senses.definitionCN: 文化每传一步都带着小变化，因此复制从不完全相同
senses.example: Cultural transmission is never exact; each generation adds its own accent.
senses.exampleCN: 文化传递从不完全精确；每一代都添上自己的口音。
senses.why: The word explains both stability and drift: the same channel that preserves a custom also lets it change.
senses.whyCN: 这个词同时解释稳定与漂移：保存习俗的同一通道也允许它改变。

intro.en: Cultural transmission joins cultural, from Latin cultura 'tilling, cultivation', with transmission, from Latin transmissio, built on trans- 'across' and mittere 'to send'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: cultural transmission 由 cultural 与 transmission 合成：cultural 来自拉丁 cultura「耕作、培养」；transmission 来自拉丁 transmissio，由 trans-「越过」与 mittere「送出」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Cultura came from colere 'to till, cultivate, worship'; it first named farming and later the tending of the mind.
items.cn: cultura 来自 colere「耕作、培养、敬奉」；先指农耕，后指心智的培养。

items.en: Mittere meant 'to send, let go'. Its deeper origin is not established, so no earlier form is given with confidence.
items.cn: mittere 意为「送出、放走」。其更深来源未得到证明，因此无法有把握地给出更早形态。

items.en: Trans- 'across' plus mittere produced transmittere 'to send across', and the noun transmissio named the act of sending through.
items.cn: trans-「越过」加 mittere 构成 transmittere「送过去」，名词 transmissio 指传送的动作。

items.en: English transmission appeared in the fifteenth century for passing something through or along, including disease and signals.
items.cn: 英语 transmission 在十五世纪出现，指把某物传过或传下，包括疾病与信号。

items.en: Anthropology adopted the phrase for culture learned from others, and later split it into vertical, horizontal and oblique routes.
items.cn: 人类学采用这个短语指从他人学来的文化，后来又把它分为纵向、横向与斜向路径。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): the first use of the exact phrase is not fixed, and the pre-Latin origin of mittere is unsettled, so any older form is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：这个确切短语的最早使用无法确定；mittere 在拉丁语之前的来源亦无定论，凡更早形态均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one shares the transmission stem; group two holds terms for culture being passed on.
note.cn: 第一组共享 transmission 词干；第二组是文化被传递的相关术语。

entries.definition: To send or pass something on; culture can be transmitted without being taught formally.
entries.definitionCN: 指送出或传下某物；文化可以不经正式教学而传递。

entries.definition: The act of passing something on; the phrase adds that the content is culture.
entries.definitionCN: 指传递的动作；短语补充内容为文化。

entries.definition: A person or device that sends something on, often used of signals or disease.
entries.definitionCN: 指传递某物的人或装置，常用于信号或疾病。

entries.definition: Describes something able to be transmitted, such as a trait or an infection.
entries.definitionCN: 描述可被传递之物，如特质或感染。

entries.definition: What is received from predecessors, often including genes as well as culture.
entries.definitionCN: 指从前辈接收之物，常同时包含基因与文化。

entries.definition: The process of learning the culture one grows up in, a form of transmission within a group.
entries.definitionCN: 指习得自己成长其中的文化，是群体内传递的一种形式。

entries.definition: Movement of traits between societies rather than from one generation to the next.
entries.definitionCN: 指文化特质在社会之间移动，而非代际之间。

entries.definition: The broader process of learning how to live in a society, which includes but exceeds transmission.
entries.definitionCN: 指学习如何在社会中生活的更广过程，包含传递但不止于此。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real routes, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实路径，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: trans- 'across' plus mittere 'send': to send culture across time and people.
normal.cn: trans-「越过」加 mittere「送出」：把文化送过时间与人。

normal.en: The family runs transmit, transmission, transmitter, transmissible.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 transmit、transmission、transmitter、transmissible。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: vertical cultural transmission, cultural transmission across generations.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：纵向文化传递、跨代文化传递。

normal.en: Remember the three routes: vertical from parents, horizontal from peers, oblique from other adults.
normal.cn: 记住三条路径：纵向来自父母，横向来自同伴，斜向来自其他成年人。

normal.en: The phrase explains both why customs last and why they slowly change.
normal.cn: 这个短语同时解释习俗为何延续、又为何慢慢改变。

abstract.en: Picture a tool changing hands while the rhythm of using it is also handed over.
abstract.cn: 想象工具易手时，使用它的节奏也一并交出。

abstract.en: Picture a song taught by singing, not by writing it down.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌靠唱来教，而非写下来。

abstract.en: Picture a copy of a copy, each slightly blurred and each still recognizable.
abstract.cn: 想象复制品的复制品，每一份都略模糊，却仍可辨认。

examples.en: Language is the most studied case of cultural transmission because it leaves records.
examples.cn: 语言是文化传递研究最多的案例，因为它留下记录。

examples.en: The school turned informal cultural transmission into a fixed curriculum.
examples.cn: 学校把非正式的文化传递变成固定课程。

examples.en: Cultural transmission across generations explains why recipes survive migration.
examples.cn: 跨代文化传递解释了为何菜谱能在迁徙中留存。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「cultural（文化的）+ transmission（传递）」——把文化像接力棒一样传下去，每一棒都带点自己的痕迹

root: cultural 来自拉丁 cultura「耕作、培养」，源于 colere；transmission 来自拉丁 transmissio，由 trans-「越过」与 mittere「送出」构成。mittere 更早的来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one handover: culture is passed through parents, peers, other adults, speech, skilled hands and institutions, and every handover changes the copy a little.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一次交接展开：文化经父母、同伴、其他成年人、言语、熟练的手与机构传递，而每一次交接都让复制品略有不同。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn hand passing a tool to a young hand, with rhythm and taboo going along with it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双老手把工具递给一双年轻的手，节奏与禁忌随它一起交出。

branches.en: THE CHANNEL: culture moves by learning, not by genes.
branches.cn: 通道：文化靠学习移动，而非靠基因。

branches.en: VERTICAL: parents are the first teachers.
branches.cn: 纵向：父母是第一任教师。

branches.en: SIDEWAYS AND DIAGONAL: peers and other adults open routes beyond the family.
branches.cn: 横向与斜向：同伴与其他成年人开辟家庭之外的路径。

branches.en: SPEECH AND HANDS: songs need listeners, skills need demonstration.
branches.cn: 言语与手：歌需要听者，技能需要示范。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS AND DRIFT: schools stabilize the copy, while every step alters it.
branches.cn: 机构与漂移：学校稳定复制品，而每一步都在改动它。

intro.en: The phrase can be read from a Latin noun for cultivation and a Latin verb meaning to send across.
intro.cn: 这个短语可以按表示耕作的拉丁名词与表示「送过去」的拉丁动词读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin cultura supplies culture and cultural; Latin mittere supplies transmit, transmission and transmitter, while trans- fixes the direction across.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 cultura 衍生 culture 与 cultural；拉丁 mittere 衍生 transmit、transmission 与 transmitter，trans- 固定了越过的方向。

items.example: The verb supplies the farming image.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供农耕意象。
文化知识在人与人之间传递。

items.example: The prefix marks movement across time or groups.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标记越过时间或群体。

items.example: The verb supplies the act of sending.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供送出的动作。

items.example: The compound names sending something through.
items.exampleCN: 这个合成词指把某物送过去。

items.example: Transmission carries culture beyond one life.
items.exampleCN: 传递把文化带出单个人一生。

items.example: The transmitter passes the signal on.

derivatives.meaning: the act of passing something on
